main.description: What a segment is like now, from a rider who was just on it (segments/trail-reports): condition tags, a short note and photos. Public: stored only in the author's repo, never in a space, and names its author. The AppView accepts a new one only while the segment is active and not a lift, from an athlete with an effort on it that began in the 30 days before it was indexed, at most 5 per author and segment in a UTC day, and only when it holds a known tag or a photo. A rewrite keeps its first indexing time.

conditions.description: Condition tags: dry to ice describe the surface, the rest what is on the trail. Unknown values are ignored.

images.description: Photos, re-encoded by the client without their metadata, location included.
